messages:
incident-bot: PAGED oncall -- p99 latency spike detected for customer 'Orion Financial' (tenant: orion-prod) in ap-southeast-1. p99 = 4.2s (SLO 1.5s). Alerts: waveform/latency-service, dedicated-pool-orion-ap. Priorities: customer-impacting.
Maya Patel: on it. grabbing logs + perf dashboard. assigning warroom.
Maya Patel: @Liam can you join for routing/traffic rules? Harish pls look at runtime/kv cache behavior.
Liam Chen: joining. seeing a sudden jump in queue depth for their dedicated pool, instances at 95% GPU mem, kernels thrashing.
Harish Kapoor: could be KV cache invalidation flood from a bad customer rollout. checking recent model rollouts pinned to orion-prod.
Amelia (Orion CS): Orion Ops reports increased latencies starting ~ 10:22 UTC, multiple customer endpoints time out. They're actively receiving support tickets.
Zoe (AM): flagged as high priority to execs at Orion. they'll expect mitigation ETA ASAP.
Maya Patel: quick triage plan: 1) isolate tenant traffic to avoid cross-tenant interference 2) scale dedicated pool by +2 gpus in same region 3) enable fallback to quantized model variant for low-priority routes 4) throttle batch size for heavy requests 5) notify customer.
Liam Chen: isolating now. running playbook: `scripts/tenant-isolate --tenant orion-prod --region ap-southeast-1`
deploy-bot: deploy job started: tenant-isolate-1765023456 (CIID: dpl-9f3).
Harish Kapoor: found a recent eval job from orion that re-requested large context completions concurrently. KV cache churn confirmed.
Maya Patel: marking requests from orion as low-priority except transactions endpoints. applying rate-limit for non-critical routes.
Liam Chen: scaled pool: `rci scale pool orion-ap 2 --type p4d` completed. new nodes joining, but warmup may take ~40s.
OrionOps-bot: Orion team: seeing partial recovery for some endpoints, but p99 still ~2.8s. Appreciate updates.
Maya Patel: enabling fallback routing to quantized model: `routing set orion-prod --fallback q4f --threshold 1.2s`
Harish Kapoor: enabling aggressive KV prefix caching for orion (ttl 15m) to reduce recomputation.
Liam Chen: rerouting some non-latency-sensitive traffic to eu-south-1 temporarily to relieve ap-southeast-1. adjusting smart routing policy.
Maya Patel: handoff note: @Liam will own mitigation for next 30m, @Harish will own cache/runtimes. I'll stay on for customer comms and postmortem coord.
Liam Chen: observed GPU utilization down to 70% after scale and routing changes, queue depth decreasing. p99 down to 1.6s on last 3m window.
Amelia (Orion CS): passing update to Orion Ops: "we've isolated your tenant, scaled capacity, and routed non-critical traffic off region. Expect normal latency within minutes."
Zoe (AM): noted for billing/credits discussion. capturing timeline.
Maya Patel: rechecking SLO impact: windows affected ~10:22–10:48 UTC. collecting spans for trace-driven QoE analysis.
Harish Kapoor: adding flags to prevent the customer's eval job type from triggering full-context refreshes until we patch the client. also prepping hotfix to KV eviction policy.
Liam Chen: creating temporary quota for orion to prevent future bursts: `quota set orion-prod --max-concurrent 60` (was 200).
Maya Patel: customer-facing update prepared: "We have mitigations in place; performance restored for most endpoints. We will follow up with root cause and long-term fixes." Amelia will send.
deploy-bot: tenant-isolate-1765023456 finished successfully.
OrionOps-bot: Orion: confirm you are seeing <1.8s p99 now?
OrionOps-bot: (customer): Confirmed, core endpoints now ~1.1s. Non-critical still being validated.
Maya Patel: marking warroom stable. actions: postmortem, KV eviction patch, adjust routing thresholds, quota guard for enterprise tenants, CS follow-up for credits.
Zoe (AM): capturing exec summary for Orion.
Amelia (Orion CS): will send formal update + timeline within 30m.
Maya Patel: handing off to oncall followup rotation @Liam. please keep incident thread updated with any regressions.
Liam Chen: will monitor for 2h, will escalate if p99 rises >1.8s.
Maya Patel: thanks all. closing active warroom — moving to followup channel. :white_check_mark:
